series.name: ONL Series online UPS
series.notes: Official ONL-1000/3000 datasheet: LCD FAULT indicator only — no numeric sub-codes.

meaning.en: LCD shows FAULT among LINE, INV, BAT, BYPASS, FAULT, BAT/LOAD LEVEL — no numeric sub-codes published
meaning.ur: LCD par fault asharh — koi number wala code nahin

causes.ur: Aam fault ya protection trip (neeche dekhein)

causes.en: Overload, mains or battery protection trip
causes.ur: Load, mains ya battery ki protection trip ho gayi

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before checking the connections.
solutions.ur: Connections check karne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Watch the other LCD indicators — LINE, INV, BAT, BYPASS — with FAULT to see which protection tripped.
solutions.ur: FAULT ke saath doosre LCD indicators — LINE, INV, BAT, BYPASS — dekhein ke kaun si protection trip hui.

solutions.en: Check mains input, battery and load, clear the cause and power cycle once; if FAULT stays, the UPS goes to a service centre.
solutions.ur: Mains input, battery aur load check karein, wajah door karke ek baar power cycle karein; FAULT bani rahe to UPS service centre jaye.

notes.ur: STABIMATIC Co.Ltd, UK — wahan footer mein likha hai
